FINAL SQL:
WITH win_counts AS (
    SELECT winner_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id
),
top_winner AS (
    SELECT winner_id
    FROM win_counts
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
latest_rank AS (
    SELECT r.player_id, r.ranking_points
    FROM rankings r
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_id, MAX(ranking_date) AS max_date
        FROM rankings
        GROUP BY player_id
    ) lr
    ON r.player_id = lr.player_id AND r.ranking_date = lr.max_date
)
SELECT players.first_name || ' ' || players.last_name,
       latest_rank.ranking_points
FROM top_winner
JOIN players ON players.player_id = top_winner.winner_id
JOIN latest_rank ON latest_rank.player_id = top_winner.winner_id;
